title: GoOrganicAfrica readiness batch 05 - Burkina Faso administrative geography

administrative_geography.effective_reorganisation: July 2025; the prior 13-region structure was replaced by 17 regions and 47 provinces.
source_findings: The Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility states the country was reorganised from 13 to 17 regions and 45 to 47 provinces.
The 17 current region names are listed in the Presidency's July 2, 2025 Council of Ministers report.
The government described a six-month transition period; October 2026 reporting confirms governors of the four new regions were appointed in October 2026.

calculator_readiness.crop_area_production_yield: official 2024/25 survey and crop-level regional extraction pending
calculator_readiness.farmgate_prices: dated regional farmgate prices and units pending
calculator_readiness.inputs_and_operations: seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs pending
calculator_readiness.currency: XOF already recorded in country registry; validate price units and conversion method
calculator_readiness.tests: country-region-crop calculation and localization tests pending

safeguards: Do not use the obsolete 13-region list in new calculator entries.
Do not treat national cereal output as regional crop yields.
Do not use wholesale prices as farmgate prices.
Do not activate the country until regional crop data, price/cost inputs and calculator tests are validated.
No existing active country profile or calculator formula was modified.
next_step: Extract official 2024/25 crop survey tables by the new 17-region geography, resolve crosswalks where survey data use the pre-reorganisation 13-region geography, then obtain dated regional farmgate prices and production costs.
